localizedValues.name: C1-Skagit
localizedValues.description: Pet Friendly. Per night pet fee applies, declare pets and pay fee when you make reservation or check in at the park. Read and understand pet rules. The cabins are tucked in an alder and fir forest, just an easy 1/2 mile walk to the Skagit River.  They are furnished with log bunk beds that sleep three, a queen size log futon, 3 small log end tables and a 4 person log dining room table, mini-fridge, microwave, single cup coffee marker, counter space with cupboards, bathroom with shower.  Cabins have a heating wall unit and a ceiling fan with lights. Renters should bring their own bedding, pillows, and towels as no linens are provided. All cabins are 16' x 25' plus a 6' covered porch, 2 adirondack chairs, fire pit, picnic table and stand up barbeque brazier. Only cooking in the microwave is allowed inside. All other cooking must be done outside.

localizedValues.name: S1-Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description:
Picnic shelter in main park day use area - open fireplace, water, lights, electricity.
A Special Activity Permit is required for the following: Weddings and large events over 20 people, large items brought into the park, event rentals, vendors, food trucks, etc. Please contact the park in advance at (360) 387-1550 to obtain a permit.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
